1.why: The screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with clear label/heading hierarchy and comfortable line spacing, though the dark 'Logs' panel uses small monospace text.

2.why: All visible copy is short sentence-case text with no italics, no all-caps and no dense paragraphs.

3.why: The layout is a single narrow centred column that would adapt to a phone, but the screenshots are rendered in a desktop viewport with large empty side margins and no actual mobile rendering shown.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Confirm your account details before setting up payment security.' are one short line in plain language.

5.why: Both fields show format examples as placeholders ('marcus@example.com', '+15551234567') plus a note pointing to the placeholder details.

6.why: No screen contains more than a couple of short lines of text before the user can act.

7.why: The flow never reaches any code or secret display, so no copy affordance for long codes exists in any screenshot.

8.why: No QR code or manual-entry alternative appears; the authenticator setup step is marked INCOMPLETE and never renders.

9.why: Email and mobile fields are standard inputs with labels, but no autocomplete attributes, password field or password-manager support is demonstrated, and values appear only after retyping.

10.why: The 'Continue' button is a prominent filled primary action, but there is no step indicator or progress marker at all, so the current step in the enrolment journey is unclear.

11.why: There is one primary button per screen, but the sign-in screen asks for two separate inputs and an extra 'Logs' panel competes for attention.

12.why: After pressing Continue the system only shows 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' and stays on the same page, never stating what happened or what comes next; the log panel still reads 'No simulated delivery yet.'

13.why: The user can press Continue again without penalty, but there are no reveal/hide or re-request code controls because codes are never issued.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' does not blame the user but also fails to state the actual problem or how to fix it, and it is not tied to any specific field.

15.why: No countdown timers or expiry warnings are visible, but since no code-entry screen is ever reached the generosity of code-entry time cannot be confirmed.
